in West Africa.

And when, I think when I last came on here, it was right after I started a chocolate company and I had no idea like how bad it was.
And the last few years I've been trying to figure out how we can build our own supply chain where we can actually get kids out of illegal child labor.
And there's, it's like, really, I don't know if you're interested in it, but it's like a lot of stuff I'd love to share on that.
